description: Defines the HostCache class used for caching DNS host resolution results, including nested classes for cache keys, entries, and staleness, along with methods for cache management, serialization, and testing.

classes.name: HostCache
classes.description: Main class for DNS host resolution result caching, managing cache entries, serialization, and cache invalidation.

classes.name: HostCache::Key
classes.description: Represents a unique key for cache entries, including hostname, DNS query type, resolver flags, source, and security.

classes.name: HostCache::Entry
classes.description: Stores DNS resolution results, including IP addresses, errors, TTL, and metadata.

classes.name: HostCache::EntryStaleness
classes.description: Indicates how stale a cache entry is, based on expiration and network changes.

classes.name: HostCache::PersistenceDelegate
classes.description: Interface for persistent storage interactions, allowing cache data to be saved asynchronously.

methods.name: HostCache::Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a valid cache entry for a given key at a specific time.

methods.name: HostCache::Set
methods.description: Adds or updates a cache entry with a specified TTL.

methods.name: HostCache::Invalidate
methods.description: Marks all cache entries as stale due to network change.
